rows.text: Something doesn't feel right on the Express... like there's something I can't see...
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Come back and see me when you have time!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: A conductor shouldn't be this timid.
A conductor shouldn't be this timid.
Come back in this instant! If we don't solve this, the Express won't be moving an inch!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom
